breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the direction of the gravity vector. The ground truth specifies `g (0 0 -9.81);` to correctly model buoyancy-driven convection where gravity acts vertically downwards. The generated specification repeated the original incorrect instruction from the user, `g (-9.81 0 0);`, which applies gravity horizontally and would not produce the desired Rayleigh-Bénard convection.
